q2_gaps: predicative 'as'-complements ('appear / serve / act as N'): the instruction set has no form for a category-ascribing complement, so it falls through to the preposition-named oblique (As <event> <kind>), which records the phrase but not that a category is ascribed to the subject

how a framing/domain PP ('in physics') attaches when the clause is a generic rule: there is no single claim atom to serve as the (In <what-is-claimed> ...) first argument, so it lands on the per-instance Skolem event instead of on the claim
notes: The bare-plural verbal generic correctly becomes a distributing Implication with a Skolem-function event at 0.9/0.9 and no QuantifierPhrase companion; stative 'appear' takes Experiencer on its intransitive subject, and both compounds emit genus plus the adjectival-modifier genus as specified.
